# Third-party files

- `three.min.js`: three.js r128, MIT licence (`LICENSE-three.txt`). It is inlined into `index.html` by `web/build.py`.
- `fonts/*.woff2`: Saira Stencil One and Saira Condensed (Latin subset, from the `@fontsource` npm packages, version 5.3.0),
  SIL Open Font Licence 1.1 (`fonts/OFL-*.txt`). They are inlined into `index.html` as well.
